# Adding or overriding a model entry at runtime

## When to use

- Adding a new model to the live catalog without restarting or recompiling the worker.
- Overriding a compiled-in seed entry with updated metadata — pricing, context window, new capability flags.
- Syncing a provider's model list from a registry-sync worker or operator CLI tool.

## Notes

- Required fields on the `Model` object are `id`, `provider`, `api`, `display_name`, and `context_window`. Missing required fields surface as an error.
- The compiled-in seed is loaded into state only when state is empty at startup. Once registered, an entry persists across restarts as long as the engine state backend is durable.
- Registered entries take precedence over the seed and are never overwritten by subsequent boots.
- To remove a model, call `state::delete` with scope `models` and key `models:<provider>:<id>`. There is no dedicated unregister function.
